what: On first open a background-color curtain covers the screen, and after .3s a 1px horizontal line in the center stretches from the center to both ends in the second color (left half) and accent color (right half) over .3s power4.in, then the same line withdraws toward both ends over .6s power4.in, and the curtain splits from the center up and down over .5s power2.out and clears. Sending fx:cover draws the line once with no curtain (page-transition cover) and emits fx:covered

options.delay: Wait before the line extends (sec), default .3
options.shrink: Length (s) for the line to clear toward both ends, default .6
options.open: Duration of the curtain splitting up and down (s), default .5 — fx:done when fully lifted
options.veil: When off, shows only the line with no cover (the line that slides under the header)
options.--fx-left: Left half line color (via style), default var(--kf-accent-text)
options.--fx-right: Right-half line color (via style), default var(--kf-accent)
options.--fx-line-top: Line height slot (set via style), default 50%
options.fx:cover: Send this event to an element and only a line stretches once, with no curtain, then retracts and fires fx:covered — send it when a link is clicked and, on fx:covered, move on to the original page transition

use:
— The page-turn line is
On fx:cover

from.where: shared.js opening() (first page loader — pink and sky-blue half-and-half line over a white curtain) · cover() (barba transition — the same line under the header stretches for .3s and lifts away over .6s)

note: In the original, after the curtain lifts the header drops in from -10rem above over .6s power1.in — that is the page’s job, so attach it after fx:done
